title: Diffusion of a polaron in dangling bond wires on Si(001)
abstract: Injecting charge into dangling bond wires on Si(001) has been shown to induce polarons, which are weakly coupled to the underlying bulk phonons. We present elevated temperature tight binding molecular dynamics simulations designed to obtain a diffusion barrier for the diffusive motion of these polarons. The results indicate that diffusion of the polarons would be observable at room temperature, and that the polarons remain localised even at high temperatures.
